input:
Classify this inbound lead as enterprise, mid-market, or SMB. Respond with only the segment name.

Acme Robotics, 4,200 employees, Fortune 500 supplier.

Extract the opportunity ID and the requested discount percentage from this email body. Return JSON with keys opportunity_id and discount_pct.

Hi team, on OPP-88421 the customer is asking for 22% off list. Can we do it?
Convert this date to ISO 8601: March 3rd, 2026

Label the sentiment of this support note as positive, neutral, or negative. One word.

"Renewal went through fine, no issues."
Normalize this account name to our canonical form: ACME ROBOTICS INC.

Extract every product SKU mentioned below as a comma-separated list, no explanation.

Quote includes PA-5220, PA-3410 and two units of PAN-SVC-PREM.

Is this an inbound lead or an outbound reply? Yes or no is not enough; answer with one word: inbound or outbound.

"Following up on my last email..."

Tag this opportunity with the closest industry vertical from the list: healthcare, finance, retail, public sector, manufacturing.

Customer: Northwind Hospitals Group

Format this contact block as a JSON object with keys name, title, email.

Jordan Ellis, VP Security Operations, jellis@northwind.example
Translate this quote acceptance line into Spanish: "Your quote has been approved."

Pull the renewal date out of this text. Just the date.

Contract term ends 2026-11-30 with auto-renew disabled.

Which of the following best describes this request: quote change, support escalation, or billing question?

"Invoice 4471 shows the wrong PO number."

Extract the buyer contact name and role.

Thanks, Priya Raman (Director of IT Procurement)

Score this lead 1-5 for fit against our ICP. Number only.

180-seat logistics company, no security team, evaluating firewalls.
Parse the quote number from the subject line: "RE: Q-2026-00913 pricing"

Categorize this discount request as standard, elevated, or exception. One word only.

Requested 15% on a 3-year term.

True or false: this account already has an active support entitlement.

Entitlement status: ACTIVE, expires 2027-01-04.

Reformat this address block onto one line.

1200 Market Street
Suite 900
Austin, TX 78701

Extract the ARR figure. Output only the number.

The renewal lands at $412,000 annual recurring revenue.

Classify the urgency of this note: low, medium, or high.

"Customer's evaluation ends Friday and they still have no quote."

Summarize this discovery call transcript for the account team in five bullet points. Cover pain points, current vendor, timeline, budget signals, and next steps.

The call ran forty minutes. The prospect described repeated firewall policy drift across three data centers, an incumbent contract expiring in Q4, and a security team of four that is already stretched. They mentioned an internal budget cycle that closes at the end of October and a preference for an evaluation before committing. Procurement wants a two-year term rather than three. The champion is the director of infrastructure; the economic buyer is the CIO, who did not attend. Competitive evaluation includes one other vendor. They asked for reference customers in logistics.
Draft a follow-up email to the champion recapping our pricing conversation and proposing next Tuesday for a technical deep dive.

Write a one-paragraph executive summary of this quote for the approval ticket.

Quote Q-2026-00913: 12 units PA-5220, 3-year premium support, 18% discount, total $1.24M, term starts 2026-10-01.

Rewrite this discount justification so it is suitable for the deal desk audience rather than the customer.

We really need this one, the customer is pushing hard and the quarter is closing.
Explain our standard payment terms to a first-time buyer in plain language.
Draft three subject lines for a re-engagement campaign aimed at closed-lost opportunities from last year.
Summarize the discount policy section that applies to a 22% request on a two-year term, and quote the relevant sentence.

Describe what changed between version 3 and version 4 of this quote for the customer-facing summary.

V3: 10 units, 15% discount, 2-year term. V4: 12 units, 18% discount, 3-year term, premium support added.
Outline the renewal talk track for an account that churn-risk scored high but has an engaged champion.

Paraphrase this policy clause for a sales rep who is not a lawyer.

"Discounts exceeding twenty percent (20%) of list price require written approval from the regional vice president prior to quote issuance."
Compose a short internal note telling the account executive that their quote was approved with conditions.
Explain to the customer why we cannot backdate the contract start date, citing our standard terms.

Summarize this quarter's pipeline notes into a status paragraph for the weekly forecast call.

Seven open opportunities above one hundred thousand dollars. Two slipped from last quarter for procurement reasons. One is blocked on a security review. Three are in late-stage negotiation with legal redlines outstanding. The largest is a manufacturing account evaluating against an incumbent, with a decision expected in six weeks. Two early-stage deals came from the partner channel and have not yet been qualified. Overall coverage is roughly two point four times the target, which is thin for this stage of the quarter given historical close rates and the seasonal slowdown that typically starts in the final two weeks.
Draft the customer-facing explanation of the approved discount, referencing the volume tier they qualified for.
Write release notes for the sales team describing the new quote approval flow.
Summarize the attached comp plan section on accelerators for a new hire.
Explain the difference between our standard and premium support entitlements for the quote appendix.
Draft a polite response to a prospect asking for a price they can take to their board next week.

Analyze this discount request against the policy hierarchy and decide whether it needs RVP approval, then explain which clause drove the decision and what the rep should do next.

Request: 26% off list on a two-year term, $840K total, competitive displacement, deal closes this quarter.

Calculate the blended margin on this quote after the requested discount, the partner referral fee, and the support attach, then tell me whether it clears our floor.

List $1,000,000. Discount 21%. Partner fee 8% of net. Support attach 18% of net at 92% margin. Product margin at list is 76%. Floor is 62% blended.
Design an approval workflow for discount exceptions that routes by deal size, discount depth, and competitive pressure, and explain the trade-offs of each threshold you pick.

Reconcile the commission statement against the closed-won records and explain every variance you find.

Statement credits $18,400 on four deals. Closed-won shows five deals, one of which was booked on the last day of the period and one of which was partially clawed back after a downgrade.

Should we approve this quote? Walk me through the policy chain, the margin impact, and the precedent risk before you answer.

24% discount, $2.1M, strategic logo, three-year term, competitor is discounting aggressively.

Compare a two-year and a three-year term for this deal on total contract value, blended margin, and renewal risk, then recommend one and justify the recommendation.

Annual list $500K, 18% discount at two years, 23% at three years, historical renewal rate 91% at two years and 84% at three.

Diagnose why this account's forecast keeps slipping. Consider the stage history, the champion change in March, the security review, and the procurement freeze, and tell me the root cause rather than a list of symptoms.
Evaluate whether we should escalate this deal to the deal desk or handle it in-region. What are the risks of each path? What precedent does each set? Which policy sections govern the decision?

Derive the break-even discount for this opportunity given the deployment cost, the partner fee, and the three-year support stream, and show the intermediate steps.

Deployment $140K one time, partner fee 10% of net year one, support 20% of net annually at 90% margin, product margin 74%, list $2.4M over three years.
Plan the sequence of internal approvals needed to close this deal by quarter end, taking into account the legal redlines, the 26% discount, and the security questionnaire still outstanding.
Implement a scoring function that ranks discount exception requests by margin impact and strategic value, and explain the weighting you chose.
Troubleshoot why quotes from the partner channel are being priced at list. The pricing rules, the partner tier lookup, and the quote template all changed last month.
Prioritize these five stalled opportunities for executive attention and justify the ordering against pipeline coverage, deal size, and days-in-stage.

Forecast next quarter's discount exception volume from the last four quarters and explain which trend you are extrapolating and why the others are noise.

Q1 41 exceptions, Q2 58, Q3 52, Q4 77, with Q4 including a one-time competitive displacement program.

Analyze the quote, decide the approval path, and draft the explanation. Do it in that order and show the policy section that drove each step.

Quote Q-2026-01102, 19.5% discount, $640K, renewal with 12% uplift, customer threatening to shorten the term.
Why does this comp calculation pay less than the rep expected? Walk through the accelerator thresholds, the quota retirement rules, and the split credit policy.
Architect the data flow for pushing approved quotes back into the CRM without double-writing on retry, and note where idempotency has to live.
Optimize our approval thresholds so fewer than 15% of quotes need RVP sign-off while blended margin stays above the floor. Show the trade-off you are making.
Justify or reject this exception request and cite the specific policy clause: 30% off list, first-year-only term, $95K deal, no competitive pressure named.

Compute the prorated credit owed on this mid-term downgrade and explain the calculation to the customer.

Original: 20 units at $4,000 each, annual, started 2026-02-01. Downgrade to 14 units effective 2026-08-15. No refund on support.
